justification: Same group that earned Dillon's first win, and we're not changing who we are because of one good Sunday. Mark Andrews is locked in from the early window after a quiet week against Jacksonville -- that's a guy who gets one more week to respond, not a guy you bury, and the schedule's already made that decision for us anyway. Amon-Ra St. Brown's carrying a Questionable tag, but he's been at practice all week and told his people he's playing, and around here we take a man at his word over a label on a injury report. Cousins is riding a 28-point week into Las Vegas, Nacua and Allen earned their spots with their routes, Hampton and Corum are doing their jobs every Sunday, and the Chargers defense stays in the lineup the same way we'd have wanted it done for us. Clear eyes, full hearts -- we build it the same way whether we're 0-7 or coming off a win.
